component.name: Mouse Master
component.summary: Customize buttons, gestures and scrolling of Logitech mice

description.p: Mouse Master unlocks everything your Logitech mouse can do on Linux, on Wayland and X11 alike: remap every button, hold the gesture button and move to switch desktops or control media, tune pointer speed, SmartShift and the thumb wheel, and give each application its own setup.

ul.li: Assign built-in actions, shortcuts, commands or apps to any button
Mouse gestures and drag-to-scroll (pan) on the gesture button or any other button
Per-application profiles that switch automatically (KDE Plasma, Hyprland, Sway)
Pointer speed (DPI), SmartShift sensitivity, scroll direction and resolution
Thumb wheel actions: smooth pinch zoom, volume, tabs, desktops and more
Easy-Switch host names, battery status and low battery notifications
Works with Bluetooth, Bolt, Unifying and Lightspeed connections

description.p: Mouse Master is not affiliated with or endorsed by Logitech.
